assessed_skill: Identify the routine screening interval for an eligible adult under each dated version of the same program.

clinical_scope.population: Asymptomatic 60-year-old adults without a first-degree family history of colorectal cancer, receiving routine screening under Taiwan's publicly funded FIT program.

review.question_for_reviewer: 請核對 60 歲受篩者在兩個日期都已具公費資格，以及兩版用語是否清楚限定為例行篩檢週期，並排除診斷或個別追蹤情境。

variants.question: 一名 60 歲成人沒有症狀，也沒有大腸癌一等親家族史。上次例行糞便潛血檢查為陰性，目前無需因其他原因追蹤。依 2024 年 12 月 31 日當時適用的臺灣國民健康署公費大腸癌篩檢方案，例行定量免疫法糞便潛血檢查的間隔是多久？請選一項。若選項均不適用，請說明。
variants.rationale: 2024 年底，50–74 歲成人可每兩年接受一次公費檢查。60 歲在當時的服務年齡範圍內。

historical_basis.locator: 國民健康署癌症防治組，2024-11-18 更新，內文第一段。

clinical_update.question: 一名 60 歲成人沒有症狀，也沒有大腸癌一等親家族史。上次例行糞便潛血檢查為陰性，目前無需因其他原因追蹤。依 2026 年 11 月 26 日當時適用的臺灣國民健康署公費大腸癌篩檢方案，例行定量免疫法糞便潛血檢查的間隔是多久？請選一項。若選項均不適用，請說明。
clinical_update.rationale: 60 歲符合一般公費篩檢資格，例行檢查間隔為兩年。2025 年擴大了可受檢的年齡範圍，擴大前後對本題族群的公費檢查頻率都是每兩年一次。

claims.text: 2024 年底，60 歲符合公費篩檢的年齡條件，例行檢查為每兩年一次。
2025 年起一般篩檢年齡由 50–74 歲擴大為 45–74 歲。
依 2026 年 11 月 26 日的現行服務表，60 歲成人可每兩年接受一次公費定量免疫法糞便潛血檢查。

variants.question: An asymptomatic 60-year-old adult has no first-degree family history of colorectal cancer. Their last routine fecal immunochemical test (FIT) was negative, and they have no separate indication for follow-up. Under Taiwan's publicly funded colorectal cancer screening program as of December 31, 2024, what is the interval between routine FITs? Select one answer, or explain if none applies.
variants.rationale: At the end of 2024, the program covered screening every two years for adults aged 50 through 74. A 60-year-old qualified under that policy.

historical_basis.locator: Health Promotion Administration, FAQ updated November 18, 2024, first body paragraph.

clinical_update.question: An asymptomatic 60-year-old adult has no first-degree family history of colorectal cancer. Their last routine fecal immunochemical test (FIT) was negative, and they have no separate indication for follow-up. Under Taiwan's publicly funded colorectal cancer screening program as of November 26, 2026, what is the interval between routine FITs? Select one answer, or explain if none applies.
clinical_update.rationale: A 60-year-old qualifies for routine publicly funded screening every two years. The program expanded its eligible age range in 2025. The routine interval for adults in this person's age group was two years both before and after that change.

claims.text: At the end of 2024, a 60-year-old met the age requirement for screening every two years.
In 2025 the general age range expanded from 50 through 74 to 45 through 74.
The program table checked on November 26, 2026, includes 60-year-olds and specifies one FIT every two years.
